{{Quote|Republic Intelligence has intercepted and decoded a Separatist ''transmission''. It details the construction of a ''Subjugator-class ship'' in the Enoth system.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Hotshot (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.54|Hotshot (comic story)}}</ref>}}
The '''Enoth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] used a [[Unidentified Enoth system shipyards|shipyard]] around a [[Unidentified planet (Enoth system)|planet]] of the system to build a [[Unidentified Subjugator-class heavy cruiser|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]].
